transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I guess what made me finally ask for help is that I barely want to eat anymore. It's been weird... like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just sitting there staring at food I used to really like, and I just can't do it. I end up throwing most of it away. So, yeah, that's mainly why I'm here.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling sad, empty, or down most of the time?
No, I wouldn't really say I've felt sad or anything like that. I mean, maybe a little down sometimes, but mostly I just feel kind of... flat, I guess. Not really sad, just... not much of anything.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energetic, needed much less sleep than normal, or felt like your mood was unusually high or 'up' for several days or longer?

No, not really. I've never had a time where I felt super energetic or didn't need to sleep. I usually need my sleep, especially being on my feet at the store all day. So, no, I haven't ever felt unusually 'up' or anything like that.
Have you ever had a period in the past, before this current episode, where you felt this same kind of flatness and lack of interest in things for at least a couple of weeks or longer?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had off days before, like anyone else, where I just didn't feel like doing much. But... no, never for weeks at a time. This whole thing where I just feel flat every day is pretty new for me. Before this started, I was usually fine.
How long has this feeling of flatness and loss of appetite been going on? Can you give me a sense of when it started?

It's been about two months. I'd say it started right around the time I got this window display award at the store... and with all the attention from the district manager that came with it. Yeah, that's about when all this started.
Over these past two months, have you been feeling worried, anxious, or on edge most days?
No, I wouldn't say I've been anxious or on edge. It's more just... empty, I guess. I don't really have the energy to feel worried about much of anything.
Over these past two months since this started, have there been any days or stretches of time where you felt more like your normal self, or has the flatness been pretty much there every single day?
No, there really haven't been any good days. It's just been... pretty much the same, every single day. I haven't felt like my normal self at all since this started.
During these past two months, have you been feeling guilty about things, or like you're worthless or to blame for problems?

Yeah, I have. I just keep thinking that I really don't deserve that award... or the chance at being a supervisor. I feel guilty a lot of the time, like I somehow tricked everyone into thinking I did a good job. People keep telling me I didn't trick anyone and that I earned it, but... I just feel like I fooled them all somehow.

You mentioned feeling the same way pretty much every single day. But I'm wondering—have there been any moments, even just a few hours here or there, where you felt a bit better or noticed the flatness lift slightly, or has it truly been unrelenting without any breaks at all?
No, not really. It's just... it's been pretty unrelenting. I don't really have moments where it lifts or I feel better. It's just flat all the time.
Before these past two months, would you say your mood and energy were generally normal and stable, or had you been feeling somewhat low or flat for longer than just these recent two months?

Before these past two months... I'd say things were pretty normal. My mood and energy were fine, really. I was just doing my regular thing at work. I hadn't been feeling low or flat at all before this started.

Just to be completely clear about the timeline: in the month or two before these past two months started, were you feeling completely normal with no low mood or flatness at all, or were you already experiencing some baseline low mood or lack of energy that just got worse two months ago?
No, I was completely normal. I didn't have any low mood or... or lack of energy before two months ago. It really just started then. Everything was fine before that.

Looking back over the whole year before these past two months started, would you say your overall mood and energy were completely stable and normal, or had you noticed any periods—even if they were mild—where you felt a bit low or less interested in things, even if it wasn't as bad as what you're experiencing now?

No, honestly... it was completely normal for that whole year, too. I didn't have any times where I felt down or lost interest in things. Like I was saying, everything was just totally fine and stable until two months ago. I really didn't notice any issues before then.

When you think back to your childhood and teenage years, would you say your mood and energy were generally similar to what you experienced in that year before these past two months—feeling pretty normal and stable—or did you tend to feel a bit down or less energetic more often back then?

No, growing up was pretty normal too. I don't remember feeling down or lacking energy when I was a kid or a teenager. It was just... regular, you know? Like I said, everything was really fine until just a couple of months ago.
